t.t: What's New in Odoo 20? New Features and Changes | DataInteger
Learn what's new in Odoo 20, including AI, offline mode, eCommerce, inventory, manufacturing, project management, and the new JSON-2 API.

div.h1:
What's New in Odoo 20?
AI, Offline Mode, Better eCommerce & More.

div.p: Odoo 20 brings new features and improvements to help businesses work faster and manage their operations more easily.

Some of the biggest changes in Odoo 20 include AI features, offline mode, new eCommerce features, better inventory management, manufacturing improvements, field service improvements, better project reporting, CRM and marketing improvements, Python 3.12, PostgreSQL 15, and the new JSON-2 API. Odoo 20 also includes important technical changes that businesses need to check before upgrading.

div.span: Written by DataInteger ERP Solutions Team

div.p: Odoo 20 requires Python 3.12 and PostgreSQL 15. Custom modules, servers, and integrations should be checked before upgrading.
You can use plain language to ask Odoo to find information, create activities, update records, and perform other tasks.
Some Odoo users can continue working without an internet connection and sync their changes when the connection comes back.
Odoo 20 brings new website designs, better product pages, AI content tools, and improved shopping features.
Odoo 20 introduces the JSON-2 API and moves away from older RPC APIs.
This guide explains the main new features and changes in Odoo 20 in simple language for business users, consultants, administrators, and developers.

a.span: What Odoo 20 Means for Different Users

div.p: AI is one of the biggest new areas in Odoo 20. Instead of clicking through different menus, users can give Odoo instructions using normal language.

"Show me all quotations from ABC Ltd that are still waiting for approval." Or: "Create a follow-up activity for these customers." Odoo can use these instructions to work with business records while following the user's permissions.
AI features in Odoo 20 include:

ul.li: check_circle AI Content Creation: Odoo can help create product descriptions, product titles, marketing content, and SEO content. This can reduce the amount of time employees spend writing repetitive content.
check_circle AI for Websites: AI can help businesses improve website content, SEO, layouts, and promotional content.
check_circle AI for Business Records: Users can use plain language to assign CRM leads, create activities, update records, change statuses, and update fields.

div.p: One of the useful new features in Odoo 20 is offline mode. This can be helpful for employees who work in places where the internet connection is not always available — for example field service workers, warehouse employees, and sales teams. Users can continue working and then sync their changes when the internet connection returns.
Depending on the Odoo app, users can view, search, create, edit, archive, unarchive, and delete records without an internet connection.
When the internet connection returns, Odoo can sync the changes that were made offline.
If two people change the same record while offline, Odoo 20 includes tools to identify and review the conflict so changes are not silently overwritten.

Odoo 20 brings several improvements to websites and online stores, including new website designs, AI content tools, better product organisation, improved shopping experience, better mobile support, Click & Collect improvements, and better product combinations.

article.p: Odoo 20 includes improvements to the website builder. Businesses can use AI to help create website content and improve SEO. The new designs are also built with mobile users in mind.

Odoo 20 makes it easier to organise large product catalogs. Products can be grouped into smaller sections so customers can find products more easily. This can be especially useful for businesses with large numbers of products.
Businesses can sell product combinations across Odoo Sales, Odoo eCommerce, and Odoo POS. The same product information can be used across these channels.

div.h2: 4. Odoo 20 Inventory, Manufacturing and Field Service

div.p: Odoo 20 also includes improvements for businesses that manage stock, manufacturing, warehouses, and field service.

Odoo 20 improves areas such as stock management, product allocation, reordering, warehouses, inventory transfers, and branch and company stock movement. These changes can help businesses keep better track of their stock.

ul.li: check_circle Better Stock Reordering: Odoo 20 adds more options for setting stock levels and managing when products need to be reordered. This can help businesses avoid running out of important products.
check_circle Better Warehouse Documents: Odoo 20 includes improvements to warehouse labels and CMR transport documents. These can help warehouse teams with picking, packing, shipping, and transport.

div.p: Odoo 20 also brings improvements to project management, CRM, and marketing. Businesses can get better information about project costs, project profits, sales opportunities, customers, and marketing activities. These tools can help managers understand how projects and sales are performing.

div.h2: 6. Odoo 20 Technical Changes and JSON-2 API
div.p: Odoo 20 includes some important technical changes. These changes are especially important for businesses with custom Odoo modules or integrations.

article.p: Odoo 20 requires Python 3.12. Businesses should check their custom modules, servers, Docker setup, deployment scripts, third-party libraries, and development environment before upgrading.
Odoo 20 also requires PostgreSQL 15. Your database and server setup should be checked before the upgrade. Some Odoo features and APIs have changed or been removed — custom modules should be reviewed.

Odoo 20 moves toward the new JSON-2 API. Older XML-RPC and JSON-RPC APIs are being phased out. Integrations with Shopify, mobile apps, payment systems, shipping systems, BI tools, and other software may need to be updated.

div.h2: What Should Businesses Do About JSON-2?
div.p: Before upgrading, make a list of every system connected to Odoo. Then check which API it uses, how it connects to Odoo, whether it needs to move to JSON-2, whether permissions still work, and whether data is transferred correctly. This should be tested before the new Odoo version goes live.
Include Shopify, mobile apps, payment systems, shipping systems, BI tools, custom software, and any other external applications.
See whether each connection uses XML-RPC, JSON-RPC, or another method, and plan the move to JSON-2 where needed.
Confirm permissions still work and data is transferred correctly after the API changes.

div.h2: 8. What Odoo 20 Means for Different Users
div.p: Odoo 20 affects different people in different ways.

article.h3: For Business Owners and Odoo Users
article.p: The biggest benefits are AI features, offline work, better eCommerce, better inventory management, better reporting, and more connected business processes. You do not need to understand the technical side of Odoo to use these features.
Consultants should first check whether new Odoo 20 features can replace existing customizations. Some businesses may no longer need custom solutions because Odoo now includes the required feature.

Developers should review Python 3.12 compatibility, PostgreSQL 15, custom modules, Odoo APIs, JSON-2 integrations, third-party libraries, and database changes. Testing should be done before production.

System administrators should check servers, backups, Docker containers, deployment scripts, custom modules, third-party apps, integrations, and database setup. A system starting successfully does not always mean the Odoo upgrade is fully ready.

div.h2: 9. How Odoo 20 Works in a Real Business

div.p: The easiest way to understand Odoo 20 is to look at a normal business process. Imagine a company that sells products and also sends technicians to customer locations.
The customer can browse products, read information, and place an order through the Odoo website or eCommerce store.
The sales team can manage the customer and sales opportunity through Odoo CRM and Sales.
Odoo Inventory manages stock, product allocation, picking, packing, and delivery.
If a technician needs to visit the customer, Odoo Field Service can help manage the appointment and service work.
Odoo Accounting can track invoices, payments, costs, and business results.
These activities can work together instead of being managed in separate systems.
Before upgrading to Odoo 20, businesses should check these areas.
Make sure your servers support Python 3.12, PostgreSQL 15, and the required third-party software.
Review your custom Odoo code and check what needs to be changed.
Make a list of all systems connected to Odoo. Check your APIs, payment integrations, shipping integrations, mobile apps, marketplaces, BI tools, and webhooks.
Test the processes your business uses every day — sales orders, purchase orders, inventory, invoices, payments, manufacturing, POS, eCommerce, and the customer portal.
Do not test only with a small empty database. Use enough data to see how the system performs with real business activity.
Your employees should test the new Odoo version before the final upgrade. Make sure they can complete their normal daily tasks.
Odoo 20 is not only about one new feature. It continues to bring more parts of a business together.

article.p: AI can help users work with business information and complete everyday tasks.
Website, eCommerce, Sales, POS, and Inventory are becoming more connected.
Inventory, manufacturing, field service, planning, and logistics can work from the same business data.
Project reports, CRM information, marketing data, and other reports help businesses understand what is happening.
No. AI is one of the major new features, but Odoo 20 also includes improvements to offline work, eCommerce, inventory, field service, projects, reporting, and integrations.
